merges.summary: Release 0.1.0. Verified on main: 12 API tests, ruff, tsc + vite build, mkdocs --strict, release-notes extraction.

Production deployment and automation: Docker Compose (Postgres, API, Caddy edge serving landing, app and docs), Hetzner bootstrap and deploy scripts, CI, AI PR review, tag-driven releases and CD. Compose and workflow YAML validated; full container run pending a running Docker daemon/server. Self-reviewed.
Documentation site (MkDocs Material): overview, getting started, architecture with diagrams, AI pipeline, reminders, API reference, privacy and roadmap. Builds with --strict.
Static showcase landing page with an animated reconstruction hero and a timeline generated from the repository's own merge history. Checked at desktop and phone widths (no horizontal scroll).

React + tldraw frontend: login, teacher and student dashboards, lesson page with AI-reconstructed editable boards (KaTeX math shape), recap panel, uploads, reminders UI. Verified in the browser against the mock-mode API. Self-reviewed; tsc and vite build clean.
FastAPI backend: auth, students, lessons, board uploads, Claude reconstruction and summaries (mock mode without a key), Telegram/Resend reminders. Self-reviewed; 12 tests passing, ruff clean.
